Being based in Kempen, a well-connected location in North Rhine-Westphalia, PETREX GMBH benefits from access to important logistics networks, industrial infrastructure, and commercial opportunities within Germany and across Europe.

An introduction to PETREX GMBH can therefore highlight it as a German chemical company operating from a strategically located business address, with the potential to serve industrial clients who value consistency, technical competence, and dependable business relationships.
